name: The Parabolic Effect
source:
Hello! We invite you to be in the shoes of a poor student and spend your time enjoying the mundanity of a low-paid job in a coffee shop.

Have a nice pastime. ♥️♥️♥️

[Translated from [url=https://hummin-foxxx.itch.io/the-parabolic-effect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你好！我们诚邀你体验一名穷学生的日常生活，在咖啡馆的低薪兼职中品味平淡琐碎的时光。

祝你度过一段愉快的消遣时光。♥️♥️♥️

[译自[url=https://hummin-foxxx.itch.io/the-parabolic-effect]itch.io[/url]]
